items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Jack Willis is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: He plays trumpet. Jack Willis. Lil' Jack, yeah, I think it is, something like that. He played with one of the, several big bands. Jack Willis probably. Yeah. He's from here.

Wait a minute, I'm trying to think of another guy that's a guy. Wallace Davenport, he's played with several of the big bands from here. And then the other guy, I can't, uh, Joe, I know his name, Joe Newman.
